question: Find literature evidence describing strategies for improving the performance of SnO2-based n-i-p perovskite solar cells. Give the strategy, mechanism, and supporting citation.
final_answer: Strategy: chloride additives (FACl in the precursor) plus ADAHCl surface passivation. Mechanism: improved perovskite crystallization and morphology, with reduced surface recombination. Supporting citation: 10.1002/aenm.201803587.
